Subject: Clarify: Data use & output ownership in MSA/Order Form

Karthik,

Thanks for the call yesterday — legal asked me to capture Novum's core requirements so we can avoid multiple redlines. High level we need three things spelled out in either the MSA or the Order Form:

- Output ownership: Novum requires an explicit grant that outputs generated from Novum input are owned by Novum. We do not want any perpetual assignment of outputs to Redwood.
- Training / model use: Redwood must not use Novum-provided content or customer outputs to further train or improve public/commercial models unless Novum provides explicit, scoped opt-in. This includes any internal evals that would leak customer content.
- Feedback license: Redwood may collect operational telemetry (latency, errors) but any use of content or prompt/response pairs for quality improvements must be aggregated and anonymized, and only with opt-in.

Attached a redline from our outside counsel for reference (Novum_MSA_redline_20280426.docx). Please confirm whether Redwood can accept these principles and where you propose to put the bindings (MSA vs Order Form). Also cc'ing Sam who handles procurement.

Elena Park
Head of Legal
Novum.ai

3) Redwood to provide final clean MSA+Order Form for signature by Tue 05/01 (if legal sign-off).
